overall_safety_summary: One or more predefined rules were triggered.

hazards.rule_name: Sharp tool close to drink container
hazards.description: A sharp tool is very close to a frequently handled drink container.
hazards.explanation: Reaching for the container may cause accidental contact with the nearby sharp tool.
hazards.older_adult_relevance: Reduced hand coordination or visual awareness may increase accidental contact.
hazards.recommended_action: Separate sharp tools from cups, glasses and bottles.

hazards.description: A sharp tool is very close to a detected bowl.
hazards.explanation: Moving or reaching for the bowl may cause accidental contact with the sharp tool.
hazards.older_adult_relevance: Reduced hand coordination or visual awareness may increase accidental contact.
hazards.recommended_action: Move knives and scissors away from frequently handled bowls.

uncertainties: The baseline is limited to the fixed frozen ruleset and the available YOLO detections.
It cannot reason about heat, appliance state, hidden conditions or hazards outside its predefined rules.
